source.author: lucan
source.text: Accedunt Syriae populi; desertus Orontes, Et felix, sic fama Ninos: ventosa Damascos, Gazaque, et arbusto palmarum dives Idume.
source.text_original: Accedunt Syriae populi; desertus Orontes, / Et felix, (sic fama) Ninos: ventosa Damascos, / Gazaque, et arbusto palmarum dives Idume.
source.text_english: The peoples of Syria come up; the Orontes is deserted, and, as report says, Ninus, once fortunate; windy Damascus too, and Gaza, and Idume, rich in its groves of palms.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: versam proles tua pandet Idumen namque potest : Solymo nigrantem pulvere fratrem spargentemque faces et in omni turre furentem.
reuse.text_original: versam proles tua pandet Idumen / (namque potest ): Solymo nigrantem pulvere fratrem / spargentemque faces et in omni turre furentem.
reuse.text_english: Your offspring will reveal Idumea turned over, for it can: the brother darkened with dust of Jerusalem, scattering torches and raging in every tower.
